reader_note: The value takes Ford's five committee pages (titles, MEMBERS labels, chairs and members), the independence count and determinations, the Audit Committee literacy/expert designations, the leadership structure, the CTC report signature and interlocks roster, and the 2021-22 board changes (May's addition, Earley's retirement, size 15 to 14); all 74 selected blocks state composition facts, eight of them mixed with biography, charter, function or rationale text. Pool facts are mostly redundant with the value - the CTC page's members after the chair (Vojvodich Radakovich as successor chair, May, Thornton, Weinberg), the director cards, the Audit Committee report signature and the board committee matrix, whose membership check marks and Vojvodich Radakovich's row did not survive as text so only its column headers and Chair cells are readable. Stated nowhere in the value: Alexandra Ford English and Henry Ford III's first election at the 2021 Annual Meeting (760), the board's twelve members at the 2021 annual meeting (1472), the May 2021 renaming of the Compensation Committee (626/3096/4055) and Farley's 'Committees: N/A' card.
